title: Why a Local Partner in Arusha Matters
excerpt: Why we work with a local partner in Arusha, and what it means for you as a traveller.
body:
## Knowledge

A local team knows the parks, roads, lodges and guides from daily experience.

## Fast help

If something changes on the ground, the local team can respond immediately.

## Fair

Working with a local company keeps more income in Tanzania.

## Our partner

We work with Kilimanjaro Nature Tours in Arusha, led by Baraka Dalali. See [our partner](/our-partner/).

## How it works

See [how a tailor-made trip works](/blog/how-a-tailor-made-trip-works/). [Plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
